answer: Count jury votes SumUp-style: a collector routes one unit of max-flow per vote through an atlas of trust edges, with capacity tickets spread outward from honest seeds. A sybil farm is like a karst cave system, vast inside but reachable only through a few attack edges, so its flow, and thus its counted votes, hits a nadir set by those edges, not by how many clones it spawns. Edges that keep carrying rejected votes lose capacity.
